author: Russell Brand
description:
Trump posted "do not drop those bombs — if you do it is a major violation, bring your pilots home" directly on Truth Social. A platform he owns. Russell Brand breaks down why this moment is unlike anything we have ever seen in modern politics — international diplomacy being conducted in real time on social media, bypassing every traditional media institution, every press secretary and every diplomatic channel. Anderson Cooper had to read Truth Social posts on air to keep up. Whatever you think of Trump this is a genuinely new and revolutionary way of wielding power and the media has no idea how to handle it.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand makes the argument that the system was never built for you. The law does not exist to protect you — it exists to keep you compliant, corralled and participating obediently in structures designed to serve power. You only discover this when you step out of line. The moment you become a problem for the system, it reveals exactly what it always was. And right now the tools being built in the name of safety and convenience — digital ID, mass surveillance, information control — are the same tools that will be used to make sure you never step out of line again.
